summary: Backend engineer with seven years of experience building payment and data platforms that handle billions of requests a month. I like turning slow, fragile systems into boring, reliable ones.

workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Lead a team of 5 engineers that owns the ledger service recording every card payment, about 4 billion entries a month
• Moved the ledger from a single PostgreSQL cluster to a sharded design with no downtime, cutting p99 write latency from 180 ms to 35 ms
• Wrote the team’s on-call guide and cut pages per week from 14 to 3 by fixing the five noisiest alerts at their source

• Built the Kafka pipeline that feeds new listings into search within 90 seconds of an agent publishing them, down from 20 minutes
• Replaced a nightly batch job with incremental updates in Go, saving $40,000 a month in compute
• Mentored 3 new graduates through their first year on the team

• Added price caching to the hotel search API in Java, raising its cache hit rate from 40% to 85%
• Wrote contract tests between search and booking that caught 12 breaking changes before release
• Built an internal tool that flags tax form fields left out of new releases, used by 30 QA engineers

skillsSection.skillDetails: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis
System design, incident response, load testing, code review

volunteerExperienceSection.volunteerDescription: • Meet weekly with a student in the full-stack program to review code and practice interviews
